SELECT * FROM delivery_route WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.*, count(o.id) AS order_count, sum(o.order_amount_snapshot) AS total_amount FROM delivery_route_stop s LEFT JOIN delivery_route_order o ON o.stop_id = s.id AND o.deleted = FALSE WHERE s.route_id = #{id} AND s.deleted = FALSE GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY s.stop_seq, s.id
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery_route_stop SET stop_seq=stop_seq + 1000 WHERE route_id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.order_id AS orderId, i.product_name_snapshot AS productNameSnapshot, i.spec_name_snapshot AS specNameSnapshot, i.sale_unit_snapshot AS saleUnitSnapshot, i.ordered_quantity AS orderedQuantity, i.actual_quantity AS actualQuantity, i.ordered_line_amount AS orderedLineAmount, i.settlement_line_amount AS settlementLineAmount FROM sales_order_item i JOIN delivery_route_order o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.route_id = #{id} AND o.deleted = FALSE AND i.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY o.stop_id, o.order_id, i.sort_order, i.id

SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.order_no, o.customer_id, o.customer_name_snapshot AS customer_name, o.status, o.expect_delivery_time, o.ordered_total_amount AS order_amount, a.receiver_name, a.receiver_phone, a.address, (SELECT count(*) FROM sales_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND i.deleted = FALSE) AS item_count, CASE WHEN a.province_code IS NOT NULL THEN a.province_code ELSE c.province_code END AS province_code, CASE WHEN a.province_code IS NOT NULL THEN a.province_name ELSE c.province_name END AS province_name, CASE WHEN a.province_code IS NOT NULL THEN a.city_code ELSE c.city_code END AS city_code, CASE WHEN a.province_code IS NOT NULL THEN a.city_name ELSE c.city_name END AS city_name, CASE WHEN a.province_code IS NOT NULL THEN a.district_code ELSE c.district_code END AS district_code, CASE WHEN a.province_code IS NOT NULL THEN a.district_name ELSE c.district_name END AS district_name, CASE WHEN a.geom_crs IS NOT NULL THEN a.longitude ELSE c.longitude END AS longitude, CASE WHEN a.geom_crs IS NOT NULL THEN a.latitude ELSE c.latitude END AS latitude, CASE WHEN a.geom_crs IS NOT NULL THEN a.geom_crs ELSE c.geom_crs END AS geom_crs FROM sales_order o JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM order_address_snapshot a WHERE a.order_id = o.id ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 1) a ON TRUE LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id AND c.deleted = FALSE AND c.address = a.address AND btrim(a.address) <> '' WHERE o.deleted = FALSE
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND i.deleted = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sorting_task_item si JOIN sorting_task t ON t.id = si.task_id WHERE si.sales_order_item_id = i.id AND si.deleted = FALSE AND si.occupation_status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.deleted = FALSE AND t.status = 'COMPLETED'))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM () candidate WHERE candidate.order_id IN #{id}

SELECT count(*) FROM sales_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = #{orderId} AND i.deleted = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sorting_task_item si JOIN sorting_task t ON t.id = si.task_id WHERE si.sales_order_item_id = i.id AND si.deleted = FALSE AND si.occupation_status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.deleted = FALSE AND t.status = 'COMPLETED')

SELECT i.order_id AS orderId, i.id AS salesOrderItemId, i.sku_id AS skuId, si.sorted_quantity AS sortedQuantity FROM sales_order_item i JOIN sorting_task_item si ON si.sales_order_item_id = i.id AND si.deleted = FALSE AND si.occupation_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN sorting_task t ON t.id = si.task_id AND t.deleted = FALSE AND t.status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE i.deleted = FALSE AND i.order_id IN #{orderId} ORDER BY i.order_id ASC, i.id ASC

SELECT o.order_id, o.order_no_snapshot AS order_no, o.customer_id, s.customer_name_snapshot AS customer_name, o.stop_id, s.stop_seq, s.address_snapshot AS address, (SELECT count(*) FROM sales_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id AND i.deleted = FALSE) AS item_count, o.order_amount_snapshot AS order_amount, o.print_count, o.last_printed_at, CASE WHEN o.print_count > 0 THEN 'PRINTED' ELSE 'UNPRINTED' END AS print_status FROM delivery_route_order o JOIN delivery_route_stop s ON s.id = o.stop_id AND s.deleted = FALSE WHERE o.route_id = #{id} AND o.deleted = FALSE AND o.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY s.stop_seq, o.order_id

SELECT o.customer_id, min(s.customer_name_snapshot) AS customer_name, count(*) AS order_count, sum((SELECT count(*) FROM sales_order_item i WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id AND i.deleted = FALSE)) AS item_count, sum(o.order_amount_snapshot) AS total_amount, count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.print_count > 0) AS printed_order_count, CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.print_count > 0) = count(*) THEN 'PRINTED' WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.print_count > 0) = 0 THEN 'UNPRINTED' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END AS print_status FROM delivery_route_order o JOIN delivery_route_stop s ON s.id = o.stop_id AND s.deleted = FALSE WHERE o.route_id = #{id} AND o.deleted = FALSE AND o.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY min(s.customer_name_snapshot), o.customer_id
mapper.update: UPDATE delivery_route_order SET fulfillment_status = 'IN_TRANSIT', version = version + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{operator} WHERE route_id = #{routeId} AND deleted = FALSE AND assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fulfillment_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE delivery_route_order SET fulfillment_status = #{result}, signed_at = now(), signed_by = #{operator}, sign_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fulfillment_status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_TRANSIT') AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM delivery_route_order WHERE route_id = #{routeId} AND deleted = FALSE AND assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND fulfillment_status NOT IN ('SIGNED', 'EXCEPTION')
